output.title: BNB USDC Allocation
output.headline: Allocate 163.96 USDC into IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · BNB on BNB Chain.
output.summary: The treasury is fully liquid at 100% idle, with 1,990,283 USD total and 1,990,283 USD idle, so the allocation preserves runway while putting a small slice of idle USDC to work. The only allocatable leg is the BNB USDC vault at 163.96 USDC; the Avalanche USDC vault is temporarily paused — waiting NAV refresh, and the remaining candidates are rejected for non-whitelist access or because the BTC Real Yield vault is not deployed.

reasons.title: Capital efficiency.
reasons.body: This plan keeps 100% liquidity and 100% idle balance intact while allocating only 163.96 USDC, which is consistent with preserving runway and earning on idle capital without forcing any asset sales.

reasons.title: Liquidity.
reasons.body: The policy liquidity floor is satisfied because the treasury remains 100% liquid versus the 30% floor, and the allocation stays within the planner cap and the 100 USDC minimum.

reasons.title: Verdicts.
reasons.body: SERV reasoning validates one allocation, one defer, and three rejects: the BNB USDC vault is allocatable; the Avalanche USDC vault is temporarily paused — waiting NAV refresh because its deposit limit is 0 USDC and NAV is stale; the licensed BNB and Avalanche vaults are rejected for not being whitelisted and having 0 USDC deposit limits; BTC Real Yield is rejected because it is announced but not deployed.

steps.title: Review treasury condition.
steps.body: The treasury holds 1,990,283 USD in total, with 1,990,283 USD idle and 23 idle days. Holdings are 1,047,762.8 USD in BTC and 942,520 USD in USDC, so the allocation can be made from idle USDC without selling assets.

steps.title: Check pre-flight facts.
steps.body: The BNB USDC vault is active, open, and meets the 100 USDC minimum with risk score 92. The Avalanche USDC vault is active and open but has a 0 USDC deposit limit and stale NAV, the licensed vaults are not whitelisted, and BTC Real Yield is not deployed.

steps.title: Apply caps and concentration.
steps.body: The BNB USDC leg is capped at 163.96 USDC by the 25% vault-TVL concentration guardrail, with vault TVL at 655.87 USDC and a 25% share of TVL. The resulting share after deposit is 20%, and the cap is concentration-bound.

steps.title: Assign final verdicts.
steps.body: Allocate 163.96 USDC to IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · BNB on BNB Chain; defer IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · Avalanche as temporarily paused — waiting NAV refresh; reject the licensed BNB and Avalanche vaults for non-whitelist access and zero deposit limits; reject BTC Real Yield because it is announced but not deployed.

sections.heading: Treasury condition
sections.body: The treasury is fully idle at 1,990,283 USD, with 23 idle days and a 100% liquidity position. Policy targets runway preservation and yield on idle capital, and the current mix includes 1,047,762.8 USD in BTC and 942,520 USD in USDC.

sections.heading: Policy
sections.body: The policy liquidity floor is 30%, the maximum asset exposure is 70%, and the minimum vault risk score is 80. Live mode is opt-in, and the live redeemable minimum is 104 USDC because ceil(100 / 0.995 × 1.03) protects the position above the 100 USDC net redeem minimum after the 0.5% redemption fee with a 3% NAV buffer.

sections.heading: Proposed allocation
sections.body: Allocate 163.96 USDC into IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · BNB on BNB Chain. This leg is 25% of the vault’s TVL of 655.87 USDC, and the concentration guardrail capped it; the share after deposit is 20%.

sections.heading: Deferred (waiting NAV refresh)
sections.body: IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · Avalanche is temporarily paused — waiting NAV refresh because its deposit limit is 0 USDC and NAV is stale at 10.4 days old, with the last update at 1.090228 USDC/share. What unblocks it is a NAV refresh that restores a positive deposit limit.

sections.heading: Rejected
sections.body: IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · BNB · Licensed is rejected because it is not whitelisted and has a 0 USDC deposit limit, with stale NAV at 6.4 days old. IX High Yield Bond (USDC) · Avalanche · Licensed is rejected because it is not whitelisted and has a 0 USDC deposit limit, with stale NAV at 10.4 days old. BTC Real Yield is rejected because it is announced but not deployed, so there is no live vault to allocate to.

sections.heading: Risks
sections.body: The main risks are RWA credit risk, the daily redemption cycle, the 0.5% redemption fee, NAV drift between updates, and smart-contract and counterparty risk. Vault concentration is also relevant here: the allocated BNB leg is capped by the 25% vault-TVL concentration guardrail, so the position size is intentionally constrained.

sections.heading: Execution
sections.body: Execution mode is Simulate by default, so the BNB leg is simulated on BNB Chain mainnet and nothing is sent. For async legs, requests are processed at the next 17:00 SGT cutoff on Singapore business days, and Vaulto estimates settlement about one business day later; Live mode is only available when opted in, requires the wallet’s signature, and is capped per transaction by the guardrail.
